# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 10/23–10/25，更新于 2026-10-22）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 13 个活动，华埠露天摇摆舞之夜、四海剧团新戏《Shadow of the Unhinged》、红绸舞团中国舞公开课
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 8 个活动，Cape May 动物园 Boo at the Zoo、Keyport「Bewitched」万圣节市集、Jenkinson's 木栈道万圣节(周六/日)
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 11 个活动，1871 年洛杉矶华人屠杀 155 周年纪念、日裔美国人博物馆:动画师 Willie Ito 放映对谈、太平洋水族馆 Scarium 家庭夜
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 11 个活动，华人历史文化项目:儿童万圣节乐园、硅谷亚太电影节(周末场)、旧金山交响乐团:久石让作品音乐会(周五/六)
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 12 个活动，Wing Luke 博物馆:菲律宾裔故事分享、西雅图亚洲艺术博物馆导览+近藤家陶艺展、派克市场 The Night Shift 夜市
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 9 个活动，波士顿亚裔美国电影节(收官)、Stone 动物园南瓜灯之夜、平价艺术博览会
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 11 个活动，灯笼与传说 AAPI 市集、Tedeschi Trucks Band 演唱会、林肯公园动物园 Zoo Brews 万圣夜(21+)
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 10 个活动，亚洲协会德州中心建筑导览、亚洲协会德州中心颂钵冥想、休斯顿交响乐团万圣节音乐会(免费)
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 10 个活动，沃斯堡动物园 Boo at the Zoo、达拉斯植物园夜间讨糖、Harwood 公园万圣节露天电影
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 7 个活动，国立亚洲艺术博物馆(免费)、O Street 豪宅家庭寻宝、国家儿童博物馆万圣节夜
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 7 个活动，Heritage Hill 历史公园秋日万圣节、尔湾 Woodbridge 万圣节市集(周六/日)、安纳罕秋日节+万圣节游行
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 7 个活动，伯奇水族馆 Halloween Aglow(周五/六)、圣地亚哥动物园 HalGLOWeen、Santee Lakes 万圣节
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 9 个活动，Roswell 万圣节欢乐屋、Lawrenceville BOO Fest、亚特兰大动物园 Boo at the Zoo(周六/日)
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 9 个活动，The Tallest Man on Earth 音乐会、卡萨罗马城堡恐怖传说、多伦多鸡尾酒节晚会
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 9 个活动，华裔加拿大人博物馆《Momentum》体育展、本拿比鬼村 Haunted Village、PNE 惊魂夜 Fright Nights

- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 13 events, e.g. Greenbelt's Haunted Trail; Brooklyn Children's Museum Evening Playdate; The New Yorker Festival

- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 11 events, e.g. Scarium Family Night at the Aquarium of the Pacific; Bluey's Big Play; Boo at the L.A. Zoo
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 11 events, e.g. Lower Polk Live!; Silicon Valley Asian Pacific FilmFest; San Francisco Symphony: Joe Hisaishi
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 12 events, e.g. The Night Shift at Pike Place Market; Phoebe Bridgers: The Lost Tour; Fall Lantern Festival at Freeway Park
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 9 events, e.g. Jack-O'-Lantern Nights at Stone Zoo; Affordable Art Fair Boston; Jim Gaffigan
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 11 events, e.g. Tedeschi Trucks Band; Zoo Brews: Howls and Growls; Chicago International Film Festival
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 10 events, e.g. Hocus Pocus Pops with the Houston Symphony; Halloween at the BOOseum; Halloween in the Hangar
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 10 events, e.g. Boo at the Zoo, Fort Worth Zoo; BOO-tanical Trick or Treat; Halloween Movie Night at Harwood Park
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 7 events, e.g. Family Treasure Hunt at The Mansion on O Street; Halloween Spooktacular at the National Children's Museum; National Museum of Asian Art
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 7 events, e.g. Fall-O-Ween at Heritage Hill Historical Park; Halloween Market at Woodbridge Village Center; Anaheim Fall Festival & Halloween Parade
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 7 events, e.g. Halloween Aglow at Birch Aquarium; HalGLOWeen at the San Diego Zoo; Santee Lakes Spooktacular
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 9 events, e.g. Halloween Fun House in Roswell; Lawrenceville BOO Fest; Boo at the Zoo, Zoo Atlanta
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 9 events, e.g. The Tallest Man on Earth; Legends of Horror at Casa Loma; Toronto Cocktail Festival: Gala of Cocktails
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 9 events, e.g. Burnaby's Haunted Village; Fright Nights at the PNE; Momentum: Power and Identity in Sports, Chinese Canadian Museum
